gloss: remains; ashes of the deceased; cremated bones

definitions.gloss: remains; ashes of the deceased; cremated bones
definitions.explanation: The bones and ashes remaining after cremation, or the skeletal remains of a deceased person. In Japan, where cremation is nearly universal, this word most often refers to the cremated remains.

examples.japanese: {遺骨|いこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{墓|はか}→お墓：21734_ohaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧。
examples.english: To inter the remains in a grave.

examples.japanese: {遺骨|いこつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{骨壺|こつつぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧。
examples.english: The remains were placed in an urn and brought home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺骨|いこつ}⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The collection of war dead remains continues to this day.

notes: In Japan, after cremation (⟦{火葬|かそう}→火葬：13379_kasou⟧), family members pick up the {遺骨|いこつ} with chopsticks (⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧) in a ceremony called {骨上|こつあ}げ or {拾骨|しゅうこつ}, placing them in a {骨壺|こつつぼ} (urn). Common collocations: {遺骨|いこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧ (to pick up remains), {遺骨|いこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧ (to inter remains), {遺骨|いこつ}⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧ (collection of remains). Related terms: {遺灰|いはい} (ashes), ⟦{遺体|いたい}→遺体：14433_itai⟧ (corpse, body).
